Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner contradicted the verified data and prior tentative conclusion. Despite establishing that Henry Scheffé lived 70 years (1907–1977) and Csaba Pálinkás lived 45 years (1959–2004), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Csaba lived longer, seemingly using death year as a proxy for longevity. This is a logical error: comparing death years does not determine who lived longer when birth years differ.
